actions.content:
set -e
command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || command -v qemu-system-i386 || true
command -v telnet || true
command -v nc || true
ls -l /app/alpine.iso 2>/dev/null || true
ps -ef | grep -E 'qemu-system|alpine.iso' | grep -v grep || true
